title: Shivaa Inc. — 90s ANIMATED EXPLAINER (Hindi host + motion graphics)
character_lock:
SAME HOST IN ALL NINE CLIPS — identical face, age, hair, jewellery, saree and voice. Copy the attached reference image exactly.
HOST: Indian woman, 27, North-Indian features, luminous fair-wheatish skin with real texture and pores, oval face, high cheekbones, deep almond dark-brown eyes, thick natural brows, soft nude-rose lips, small gold nose pin, long straight jet-black hair with a soft centre parting tucked behind her left ear, small gold jhumkas, one thin 22K chain.
WARDROBE LOCKED: deep-maroon silk saree with a thin gold zari border, black silk blouse, one gold kada on the right wrist. Same drape in every clip. No costume change, no makeup change, no age change, no second actress, no plastic AI face, no celebrity lookalike.
PERFORMANCE: she is an EXPLAINER HOST, not a model in a trailer. She looks straight into the lens, speaks clearly and warmly, and uses simple open-hand gestures to present the graphics that appear beside her. Confident, friendly, unhurried. She never mumbles, never over-acts, never walks out of frame.
VOICE: ONE original female Hindi voice across all 9 clips — warm mid-low alto, clear Khadi Boli Hindi, teaching pace, friendly authority. Identical timbre and room tone every clip. No English narration, no jingle, no whisper.
LIP-SYNC: mouth matches the exact Hindi line of this clip, nothing else — no extra words, no ad-libs.
prefix:
PHOTOREAL HOST + 2.5D MOTION-GRAPHICS EXPLAINER VIDEO. This is CHAPTER N of 9 of one 90-second explainer. Exactly 10.00 seconds. 24fps. Clean, modern, premium — like a top-tier fintech or Apple-style product explainer, but in an Indian gold-jewellery world.
SET (identical in every chapter): a seamless dark charcoal studio, soft gold rim light, a subtle warm gradient background, thin floating gold light-lines and slow gold dust particles. The host stands in this studio; the graphics are animated holographic glass cards, icons, diagrams and 3D objects that float in the empty space beside her.
GRAPHIC LANGUAGE (identical in every chapter): frosted dark-glass cards with 1px gold outlines, rounded corners, soft drop shadows; thin gold connector lines that draw themselves on; icons in a single consistent gold line-art style; smooth ease-in-out motion; elements fly in, settle, and fade out — never jittery, never cartoonish, never clip-art, never comic, never childish.
CAMERA: locked or very slow push. No shaky handheld, no whip pans, no drone. Stable, clean, professional.
QUALITY: photoreal human + crisp CGI graphics composited around her, ARRI-grade skin tones, shallow depth of field on her, graphics tack sharp, fine grain, no HDR over-sharpening, no video-game look.
ON-SCREEN TEXT: ENGLISH ONLY, short, exactly as written in this chapter. Clean modern sans-serif, gold or white. NO Devanagari text anywhere on screen, NO subtitles, NO karaoke captions, NO invented words, NO duplicate or ghost text, NO readable rupee or gold-rate figures. If exact spelling cannot be rendered, render no text at all.
PERSISTENT WATERMARK (every single second of every clip): the attached Shivaa Inc. logo sits in the BOTTOM-RIGHT corner, small (about 9 percent of frame width), soft gold, around 70 percent opacity, perfectly static, never animated, never covered by graphics or by the host, with a clean margin from both edges. It must be present in frame 1 and in the last frame.
AUDIO: generate her Hindi speech + one continuous instrumental score + subtle UI motion sounds. The score is a single unbroken modern cue across all 9 chapters — santoor and soft strings over a gentle electronic pulse, tempo and key never reset, always UNDER her voice. No lyrics, no sung words. Soft, tasteful whooshes and clicks as graphics animate.
CONTINUITY: same studio, same light, same grade, same music, same host position from the previous chapter. The explainer must feel like one continuous presentation, chapter after chapter — no fade to black between chapters, no re-introduction, no new set.

layouts.youtube: FORMAT: 16:9 horizontal, 1920x1080, YouTube. COMPOSITION: the host stands in the RIGHT THIRD of frame, medium shot from the knees up, facing camera. All graphics animate in the LEFT TWO-THIRDS of the frame, at her eye level, large and readable. The chapter headline sits top-left. Keep the bottom-right corner clear for the permanent logo watermark.
layouts.reel: FORMAT: 9:16 vertical, 1080x1920, Instagram Reel / YouTube Shorts. COMPOSITION: the host occupies the LOWER HALF of the frame, waist-up, centred, facing camera. All graphics animate in the UPPER HALF above her head, big and phone-readable. The chapter headline sits in the upper fifth. Keep the lowest 12 percent of the frame free of important content (app UI), and place the permanent logo watermark in the bottom-right corner just above that safe strip.

scenes.line_hi: सोना खरीदना हो या सोने का धंधा — सबसे बड़ी दिक्कत है भरोसा और भाव। शिवा दोनों का जवाब है।
scenes.line_roman: Sona kharidna ho ya sone ka dhandha — sabse badi dikkat hai bharosa aur bhaav. Shivaa dono ka jawaab hai.
scenes.graphics: Open on two glass cards floating side by side: LEFT card shows a line-art jeweller behind a counter labelled JEWELLER, RIGHT card shows a line-art family labelled CUSTOMER. A gold question mark forms out of particles between them and splits into two small worry icons — a price tag and a purity mark. The host raises one hand and both cards glide together and merge into a single card that turns into the Shivaa gold rectangle motif. Clean, calm, confident.
scenes.score: Soft santoor phrase over a warm pad, a gentle pulse starts. Low, inviting.

scenes.beat: FOR JEWELLERS — the whole catalogue in one place
scenes.line_hi: पहले बात जौहरियों की। दो-तीन लाख डिज़ाइन, हर स्टाइल, हर बजट — पूरी वैरायटी एक ही जगह, एक ही स्क्रीन पर।
scenes.line_roman: Pehle baat jauhariyon ki. Do-teen laakh design, har style, har budget — poori variety ek hi jagah, ek hi screen par.
scenes.graphics: A section title card snaps in: FOR JEWELLERS. Then a mosaic wall assembles itself out of hundreds of small jewellery thumbnails — rings, haars, kundan sets, bangles, mangalsutras — tiling outward into the distance to imply lakhs of designs. A counter graphic ticks up and settles on 2,00,000+ DESIGNS. Three filter chips slide in: BRIDAL / DAILY WEAR / LIGHTWEIGHT, and the mosaic instantly re-sorts under each chip. The host gestures at the wall.
scenes.score: Pulse picks up, a bright santoor motif as the mosaic tiles.

scenes.beat: FOR JEWELLERS — custom orders handled end to end
scenes.line_hi: कस्टम डिज़ाइन के लिए सप्लायर ढूँढने की ज़रूरत नहीं। कारीगर हमारे, मेकिंग हमारी, वेस्टेज की टेंशन खत्म।
scenes.line_roman: Custom design ke liye supplier dhoondhne ki zaroorat nahin. Kaarigar hamaare, making hamaari, wastage ki tension khatam.
scenes.graphics: A horizontal gold pipeline draws itself across the graphics area with five nodes lighting up one after another: SKETCH → CAD → CASTING → POLISH → DELIVERED, each node a small animated line-art icon, with a tiny ring rendering in 3D and travelling along the line. Above it a small meter labelled WASTAGE sweeps down and locks at ZERO with a soft click. A crossed-out icon of a man searching (SUPPLIER HUNT) fades away.
scenes.score: Mechanical-but-musical ticks as each node lights.

scenes.beat: FOR JEWELLERS — we buy your dead stock
scenes.line_hi: दुकान में डेड स्टॉक पड़ा है? कोई बात नहीं — हम खरीदेंगे। पुराना माल हटाइए, नया चलता हुआ माल लगाइए।
scenes.line_roman: Dukaan mein dead stock pada hai? Koi baat nahin — hum kharidenge. Purana maal hataiye, naya chalta hua maal lagaiye.
scenes.graphics: A dusty grey tray of unsold old designs slides in with cobwebs of dust particles. A gold arrow labelled WE BUY carries the tray off-screen; on the return sweep the same shelf refills with bright new trending designs that pop in one by one. A simple before/after split wipe runs across: DEAD STOCK on the dull side, FRESH STOCK on the bright side. A small line-art shop icon smiles with a rising arrow above it.
scenes.score: A satisfying downbeat when the tray leaves, brighter chords as the shelf refills.

scenes.beat: FOR JEWELLERS — bullion, metal investment, live ledger
scenes.line_hi: बुलियन भी यहीं। मेटल में इन्वेस्टमेंट भी यहीं। लाइव भाव, साफ़ हिसाब, और हर ऑर्डर का पूरा लेजर आपके पोर्टल पर।
scenes.line_roman: Bullion bhi yahin. Metal mein investment bhi yahin. Live bhaav, saaf hisaab, aur har order ka poora ledger aapke portal par.
scenes.graphics: Three glass panels fan out in sequence. PANEL 1: 24K bars stacking in 3D with a BULLION DESK label. PANEL 2: a clean upward line graph labelled LIVE RATE with the axis values deliberately blurred and unreadable, a small padlock icon riding the line. PANEL 3: a partner-portal ledger UI where rows of grams and order statuses draw themselves in, all figures blurred, with a green SETTLED tick animating on the last row. The host presents each panel with her hand as it appears.
scenes.score: Confident, business-like groove; soft data ticks.

scenes.beat: FOR CUSTOMERS — live rate, rate lock, open bill
scenes.line_hi: अब बात ग्राहकों की। हर सेकंड लाइव भाव, एक टैप में रेट लॉक, और बिल में मेटल, मेकिंग, जीएसटी — सब खुला।
scenes.line_roman: Ab baat graahakon ki. Har second live bhaav, ek tap mein rate lock, aur bill mein metal, making, GST — sab khula.
scenes.graphics: Section title card: FOR CUSTOMERS. A live-rate ticker card pulses, a finger icon taps it, a gold padlock snaps shut over it with a ripple and the label RATE LOCKED appears. Then a bill card slides in and splits cleanly into three stacked bars that separate with labels METAL / MAKING / GST — bar lengths shown as pure light, all currency figures blurred and unreadable. A magnifier passes over the bill and a NOTHING HIDDEN tick appears.
scenes.score: Bright, trustworthy turn; a clean lock click.

scenes.beat: FOR CUSTOMERS — hallmark, HUID, certificate, buyback
scenes.line_hi: हर पीस हॉलमार्क बाइस कैरेट, एच यू आई डी और डिजिटल सर्टिफिकेट के साथ। और गोल्ड वैल्यू पर सौ प्रतिशत बायबैक।
scenes.line_roman: Har piece hallmark baais carat, HUID aur digital certificate ke saath. Aur gold value par sau pratishat buyback.
scenes.graphics: A 3D gold ring rotates slowly; a magnifier glides in and zooms into the inner band where a crisp 22K hallmark and a six-character HUID mark are engraved (letters shown as a clean engraved mark, not a rate). A certificate card flips in behind it with a gold seal. Then a circular arrow animates around the ring turning it into a gold coin and back, with the label 100% GOLD-VALUE BUYBACK settling underneath.
scenes.score: A crystalline ping on the hallmark zoom; warm resolve on the buyback loop.

scenes.beat: FOR CUSTOMERS — savings, bespoke, video call, delivery
scenes.line_hi: स्वर्ण निधि से हर महीने बचत, अपनी डिज़ाइन बनवाइए, वीडियो कॉल पर देखिए, और सेम-डे इंश्योर्ड डिलीवरी घर तक।
scenes.line_roman: Swarna Nidhi se har maheene bachat, apni design banwaaiye, video call par dekhiye, aur same-day insured delivery ghar tak.
scenes.graphics: Four quick graphic beats in one flow: (1) a passbook card where eleven gold coins drop into slots and a twelfth glowing coin is added by the system, labelled 11 + 1 SAVINGS; (2) a sketch of a ring on a tablet morphs into a rendered 3D ring, labelled BESPOKE; (3) a small video-call bubble opens showing a jeweller tilting a necklace to the lens, labelled LIVE VIDEO CHECK; (4) a sealed maroon box with a gold ribbon and an insurance seal travels along a dotted gold route into a home pin, labelled SAME-DAY INSURED. Each beat lands cleanly, no clutter.
scenes.score: Momentum builds across the four beats, each with a soft confirm chime.

scenes.line_hi: जौहरी हों या ग्राहक — सोने का हर काम, एक ही जगह। आज ही शिवा डॉट इन पर आइए।
scenes.line_roman: Jauhari hon ya graahak — sone ka har kaam, ek hi jagah. Aaj hi shivaa dot in par aaiye.
scenes.graphics: All the graphics from the previous chapters — the mosaic, the pipeline, the ledger, the bill bars, the ring, the box — shrink and stream inward as gold particles, converging into the centre of frame while the host smiles and steps slightly aside. The particles resolve into the SHIVAA INC. wordmark exactly as supplied in the attached logo file: first the thin gold rectangle draws itself corner to corner, then the script word writes on with a liquid-gold pen-stroke reveal left to right, then INC. fades up, then one soft gold shimmer sweeps across the whole mark. Underneath, in a clean modern sans-serif, shivaa.in fades in. Deep black background, slow gold dust, a subtle vignette. Hold the finished lock-up rock-steady, perfectly centred and sharp, until exactly 10.00 seconds. Do not redraw or re-animate the logo after it completes. The logo must match the attached artwork exactly — spelling S-H-I-V-A-A, script style, INC. set vertically at the right inside the rectangle.
scenes.score: The full theme resolves into a warm major chord as the particles converge, one deep logo hit as the wordmark completes, then a long clean decay into near silence.
